incident.symptom: Pyodide import of gradio fails inside filelock because the Gradio Lite worker replaces os.link with a two-argument lambda while filelock calls os.link(..., follow_symlinks=False)
incident.trace_signature: TypeError: <lambda>() got an unexpected keyword argument 'follow_symlinks'

root_cause.failure_phase: before app.py; during import gradio -> gradio_client -> huggingface_hub -> filelock

remediation.strategy: vendor and redirect only the pinned Gradio Lite worker
remediation.new_behavior: os.link accepts *args/**kwargs and raises NotImplementedError so filelock capability probing fails safely

human_authorization.basis: Continuation of the explicitly authorized GALIA dashboard deployment and runtime repair; user supplied the traceback and directed continuation.
